Name: First Steps
Lesson: Tap an adjacent node or swipe to move one step. Reach the green exit!

Name: Follow the Lines
Lesson: You can move only along connected nodes. Find the route around the walls.

Name: Stay Out of Sight
Lesson: Red outlines show guard vision. Guards see two nodes straight ahead.

Name: Watch the Rotation
Lesson: Rotating guards turn 90° after each action. Use WAIT to change their direction.

Name: Moving Patrol
Lesson: Moving guards reach the final corridor node before reversing. The cyan NEXT arrow shows their upcoming step.

Name: Safe Side
Lesson: Plan your route around a stationary guard.

Name: Clockwise
Lesson: Wait and watch the rotating guard.

Name: One Step Ahead
Lesson: A patrol can cross your route. Watch both detection phases.

Name: Double Trouble
Lesson: Two guards watch different lanes.

Name: Corner Patrol
Lesson: Route patrols turn naturally at corners.

Name: Narrow Crossing
Lesson: Multiple patrols move together each action.

Name: Crossroads
Lesson: The safest route is not always the shortest.

Name: Predict the Return
Lesson: The cyan NEXT badge shows a patrol’s next move, including its reversal at the end node.

Name: Around the Loop
Lesson: Time your crossing with a looping patrol.

Name: Patrol Junction
Lesson: Guards never occupy the same node at a turn boundary.

Name: Find the Key
Lesson: Walk onto the key, then physically cross the locked connection.

Name: Key Detour
Lesson: The key is reusable; collecting it does not open the lock remotely.

Name: Door as Cover
Lesson: A closed door blocks sight. Opening it can expose you.

Name: Unlock at the Right Time
Lesson: Plan the guard phase before crossing the locked door.

Name: Protected Corridor
Lesson: Enemy patrols never cross locked-door connections.

Name: Camera Basics
Lesson: Amber vision starts a lockdown, not immediate capture.

Name: Race the Alarm
Lesson: Escape before the lockdown action counter reaches zero.

Name: Rotating Security
Lesson: Wall cameras rotate every action, even when facing a wall.

Name: Sweep Window
Lesson: Sweeping cameras hold each direction for two actions.

Name: Risky Shortcut
Lesson: Try a faster alarm route or a slower Ghost escape.

Name: Smoke Screen
Lesson: Tap Smoke, then tap a nearby node. Smoke blocks vision for two actions.

Name: Cloud Timing
Lesson: Smoke stays on its node while guards keep moving.

Name: EMP Training
Lesson: Tap EMP and select a wall camera. It is disabled for two actions.

Name: Security Gap
Lesson: The EMP expires after two counted actions, then the camera rechecks vision.

Name: Final Extraction
Lesson: Combine keys, Smoke, EMP and the security countdown to escape.
